people.imagined: Midnight in a fever town, but she is laughing. She sits on an upturned barrel between two cots with the gourd on her hip, needle roll open on her knee, one needle pinched in her fingers, telling the patient a very bad joke.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a barrel in a lamp-lit sick room, a silver needle held up between two fingers, laughing so hard her eyes have disappeared. Face: a round, soft, rosy old face with big cheeks; deep laugh lines; eyes squeezed to two bright curves; small plump nose; wide laughing mouth with a few gaps in the teeth; faint wine flush across the nose and cheeks. Hair: thick white hair piled into a high loose bun, and a whole cluster of fresh pink plum blossoms pinned in it, big and bright, the main thing at the top. Body: short, round and comfortable, shoulders shaking with laughter. Clothing: a healer's robe of fine green silk, crossed collar, wide sleeves, a white sash round the waist; at the hem a single small red cloud embroidered (out of frame); a white gourd hung at her right hip on a cord. Hands and objects: the right hand pinches a long silver needle with a boxwood handle up to the lamp; the left holds open on her knee a roll of green silk with eight more needles in neat slots. Background: lamp-lit cots with a blurred sleeper, a ladle in a bucket. Light: warm lamp light from the lower left on her cheeks and the blossoms, deep green shadows above. Expression: roaring, merry, tireless kindness. A faint green-blue freshness round the needle.

people.imagined: In the cold cellar between rows of sealed jars. He is holding the little half-spring, half-lake cask in both hands against his apron and speaking quietly to someone just out of sight, not quite meeting their eye.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a cold wine cellar among rows of clay jars, holding a small cask in both hands and talking softly, eyes just off to one side. Face: a heavy soft face with a double chin; pale skin with a cellar's grey chill; soft thick brows; small, pale, careful brown eyes that rarely settle; a broad flat nose; a small mild mouth in a soft smile; a close-trimmed grey stubble. Hair: thinning grey hair combed flat, no ornament. Body: big, heavy, wide-shouldered and soft, standing with the weight back. Clothing: a stiff brown leather cellarman's apron, dark with stains of every shade, over a plain brown wool shirt with rolled sleeves; round his neck on a cord hangs a heavy square seal of grey stone, no writing visible, resting on the apron bib. Hands and objects: both hands cradle a small wooden travelling cask with iron hoops against his belly; the knuckles are soft and clean. Background: rows of tall clay jars sealed with red clay stoppers, receding into dark; a lantern. Light: dim amber lantern light from the upper left, cold blue shadow in the corners. Expression: mild, reasonable, hiding a calculation. A faint cool blue-green chill.

people.imagined: The grey dawn on a road leading out of the lake country. She stands half-packed, her pack open at her feet, her sleeves cuffed and stained dark green, deciding what to leave behind for the next fever.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a road, crouched over an open pack, one hand stuffing in a bundle of herbs, looking up fiercely at someone. Face: a thin, lean, sun-browned face with sharp cheekbones; short cropped dark hair; level dark brows drawn together; sharp dark eyes, impatient and honest; a narrow straight nose; a firm mouth with the corner pulled down; a faint scratch on the jaw. Hair: cropped to the ear, black, no ornament, rough as if cut with a knife. Body: thin, wiry and tall, lean forearms, crouched on the balls of her feet over the pack with her weight forward. Clothing: a healer's robe of fine green cloth in a short travelling cut, tied up at the hip; a white sash worn tight; the cuffs of both sleeves heavily stained dark green with herb juice, the stains big and visible; leather gaiters laced to the knee. Hands and objects: the right hand packs bundles of dried herbs into a canvas road pack, the nails green at the tips; at the left wrist hangs a roll of needles on a cord. Background: a grey early road in the half-dark, a dim lantern set on the ground beside the pack, a row of low marsh reeds, and a thin mist lying over a ditch. Light: cold grey dawn light from the upper left, with a faint fresh-green glow around the herb bundles. Expression: an urgent, stern glare upward, the brows drawn hard together and the corner of the firm mouth dragged down, impatient and honest.

people.imagined: In the tasting room, in the instant before a cask is opened. Her head has already turned toward it though the lid is shut and no one has spoken. Her milky eyes stare past it. Her husband stands rigidly behind her.
people.subject: The moment: seated very still at a tasting table with her face turned precisely toward a closed cask in front of her, eyes wide open and blind. Face: a long, pale, still face with fine bones; both eyes entirely milky white, with no pupils, wide and unblinking, the first and biggest detail; thin dark brows; a narrow straight nose with flared nostrils; thin lips closed in a faint knowing smile; a small scar at the left cheekbone. Hair: black, drawn severely back into a tight low knot, no ornament but a plain white jade pin. Body: slender and upright, a stillness with no wasted motion, the head slightly tilted. Clothing: a healer's robe of fine dark green silk with a high crossed collar and long narrow sleeves, a white sash; the left cuff has a thin line of white where a taster's cloth is tucked. Hands and objects: the long pale fingers of the right hand rest flat on a round cask lid; the left hand holds a small white porcelain tasting cup, empty, held at chest height. Background: a stone tasting room with a rack of dark bottles, a blurred man's shoulder in a leather apron. Light: soft amber light from the upper left, her white eyes catching two small highlights. Expression: composed, listening with the whole face, cruel in its calm. A faint blue-green water haze.

people.imagined: Night at the cart yard. He is cracking his whip with his rough right hand while the left holds a lantern up as softly as a merchant, hurrying the carters out onto the lake road with a cheerful word.
people.subject: The moment: in a cart yard at night, coiling a whip in his right hand while holding a lantern in his left, calling cheerfully to carters. Face: a good-natured, round, clean-shaven face; warm brown eyes crinkled by an easy smile; soft brows; a short nose; a friendly mouth, lips parted mid-call; a boyish dimple. Hair: black, tied loose with a green cord, a strand across the forehead. Body: medium height, strong shoulders, relaxed stance. He stands with his chest open and his weight on the front foot, as if about to step forward and help someone; the shoulders are strong from lifting barrels. Clothing: a brown leather apron over a fine green silk jacket with rolled sleeves, like his father's but cleaner; a plain white sash; a pair of good leather boots. The green silk jacket has a high collar and frog buttons, with the brown leather apron tied over it and a white sash knotted twice; a short riding crop hangs from his belt, and a letter packet is tucked in the front of the jacket. Hands and objects: the right palm is dark, hard and calloused, drawn plainly around a coiled whip; the left hand is soft, pale and unmarked, lifting a paper lantern. Background: The yard behind him is wet cobble with a long line of covered carts, barrels lashed with rope, mules steaming, carters in dark hats checking their harness by lantern, and beyond the gate a black road to the lake with a thin pale moon. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left. Expression: an easy, trusting, hurried grin, the eyes crinkled and quick, a man calling cheerfully to a friend while his feet are already moving. A faint water-blue gleam on the barrels.

people.imagined: In the herb meadows, a carter at the gate and a refusal in progress. He stands with arms crossed, his one clouded eye turned slightly aside and the good eye fixed hard, a crushed mint sprig stuck behind his ear.
people.subject: The moment: standing with his arms folded at a meadow gate, glaring down at someone out of frame, one eye clouded white. Face: a lean, hard, long face tanned to leather; the right eye entirely clouded white and blank, big, the first mark; the left eye dark and fierce; shaggy grey-streaked brows; a hooked nose; a thin mouth turned down; a short rough beard, pepper-grey. Hair: grey-black, tied up with a twist of grass, a crushed green mint sprig tucked behind the right ear. Body: tall and lean, narrow-shouldered, in a stiff stance with the feet planted a little too far apart, like a gate himself. Clothing: a healer's robe of fine green cloth, plain, with a white sash, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, clean at the cuff but with soil at the knees; a broad straw hat hanging at his back. Hands and objects: arms crossed over his chest; the right hand, tucked under the left elbow, holds a small hoe-like iron herb knife with a short wooden handle; the knuckles are cracked and earth-stained. Background: green meadow rows of herbs laid out in strips, a rough wooden gate with a leather hinge, a blurred loaded cart waiting, and a line of low hills under a clear sky. Light: bright cool daylight from the upper left, a faint green glow in the shadows of the crushed mint. Expression: a stubborn, offended glare with the clouded eye blank and the dark one fierce, the thin mouth turned down as if the visitor had insulted his meadow.

people.imagined: A fever town at night. She is carrying a small child on her back in a green sash-sling and looking over her shoulder at the child's face, her forearm with the burned brand showing under the lamp.
people.subject: The moment: in a fever town at night, a sleeping child carried on her back in a sling, her head turned to look at it over her shoulder. Face: a young, tired, gentle face; skin pale brown with dark shadows under the eyes; soft dark brows pulled up; kind dark eyes; a small straight nose; soft lips pressed together; a strand of damp hair on the cheek. Hair: black, in a long loose braid over one shoulder, a white ribbon on the end. Body: slim and steady, leaning forward under the load, the shoulders tipped and the head turned back over one shoulder to look at the sleeping child. Clothing: a healer's robe of fine green cloth in a travelling cut, the sleeves pushed up, with the white sash wrapped round to hold the child in a sling at her back; a small needle roll hangs at the wrist. Hands and objects: the right forearm, bare, shows a brand burned into the skin, a ring of small vertical bars like barrel staves, drawn clearly; the left hand supports the child's small bare foot. Background: a fever town at night, rows of dark low houses with shuttered windows, a single yellow lamp hung at a corner, a pale rope of fog drifting along the street, and a cart left in the road. Light: warm lamp light from the upper right on her face and arm, the rest of the street in cold blue shade. Expression: a tired, tender look, the dark eyes soft with fatigue and the lips pressed together gently, all her attention on the small sleeping face. A faint green freshness.

people.imagined: Dawn in the cellar. He is slumped against a vat with a hiccup mid-hiccup, a jar in his lap, still wearing last night's smile, blaming the mash to the empty room.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn slumped against a wine vat, mid-hiccup with his hand lifted to his mouth, a small jar in his lap. Face: a round flushed face, shiny cheeks and nose red as a plum; sleepy half-closed eyes; thin messy brows; a snub nose; a loose silly grin; a smear of grain mash on the chin. Hair: brown and tousled, a bit of grain stuck above the ear. Body: soft, short, round-bellied, sprawled with legs out. The jar is clutched against his chest in both arms like a child's toy, its clay stopper hanging loose. Clothing: a brown leather cellar apron over a rumpled green jacket of good cloth; a white sash loosened and trailing. His round belly rises and falls with the hiccup, the apron slipped to one side and the green jacket rumpled, buttoned wrong by one button; a smear of grey mash dries on his chin, and his bare feet stick out, one with a hole in the sock. Hands and objects: the right hand covers his mouth in the hiccup; the left cradles a small stoppered clay jar in his lap; a wooden ladle on the floor. Background: Around him the cellar is huge and dim: a row of oak vats taller than a man with wooden stairs, strings of pale sprouted grain hanging, a heap of broken clay shards in the corner, a ladle hung on a nail, and a stripe of cold grey light from a high window falling on the floor near his feet. Light: cold grey dawn light from the upper left, warm bounce from a lamp. Expression: a sleepy, slyly pleased smile, the heavy lids half down and a hiccup trembling behind the hand, a man who has done well by the jar. A faint blue-green.

people.imagined: On the stone steps of the Dawn Hall at dusk. She sits with her cracked hands open on her knees, the white salt seams along every finger plain in the light, looking out over the lake and wishing for more Wood.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on stone steps at dusk with both hands open palm-up on her knees, looking down at the white-seamed fingers. Face: a thin, pale face with a sea-wind pink at the cheekbones; large dark patient eyes with grey shadows beneath; thin soft brows; a small nose; a small mouth with a faint hopeful curve; delicate, frail. Hair: long brown hair tied low with a plain white cord, a few loose strands lifting in the lake wind. Body: slender, narrow-shouldered, a little hollow-chested. She sits with her knees together and her feet on the lower step, her shoulders narrow and drawn in, her head bowed so that the thin neck shows; her pale lips are slightly cracked. Clothing: a healer's robe of fine green cloth, neat and clean, with the cuffs a little softened at the edge; a white sash tied in a small precise bow. Hands and objects: both hands lie open palm-up on her knees, the skin of every finger cracked and dry, a thin white line of salt along every cuticle, the clear focus of the picture; the needle roll in her lap is tied with a green ribbon. Background: Beyond her the lake stretches pale and flat to a low line of reeds, a small boat with a lantern drifting far out, a heron standing in the shallows, the stone steps of the Dawn Hall descending to the water, and a darkening sky with a few early stars. Light: pink dusk light from the upper left, soft. Expression: a quiet, wistful, hopeful look, the large dark eyes patient and a little sad, the small mouth curved very faintly, a girl making the best of a hard gift. A faint pale-blue wash around her.

people.imagined: In the herb garden's little record shed. He is at the desk, chewing the corner of a blank page with a calendar spread open, looking up at the ceiling trying to guess.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a small desk in a garden shed, chewing the corner of a paper page, eyes turned up to the ceiling in thought. Face: a long, soft, careful face; light brown skin; mild, honest brown eyes cast up; thin unmarked brows; a long nose; the lower lip pulled in and a corner of paper between his teeth; a dot of ink on the cheek. Hair: brown, shaggy, over the ears, a quill-like twig stuck in it. Body: lanky, narrow-shouldered and hunched forward over the desk. He sits with his legs tucked under the chair and one elbow on the desk, the lanky frame folded into a hunch, his neck craned back so that the Adam's apple shows; there is a pale smudge of ink on his right ear. Clothing: a healer's robe of fine green cloth, neat, with a white sash, sleeves pushed up. The green robe has a stain of crushed leaf on the front, the white sash is tied crooked, and a small pouch of pressed flowers hangs at his side. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brush above the table; the left holds the paper corner at his mouth; the desk is covered with sheets in neat columns of tiny drawings of flowers, no writing. Background: The shed is cramped, with a scatter of dried herb bunches hanging from the beams, rows of small clay pots on a shelf, an open window onto bright meadows with a line of green beds, a half-eaten rice cake on a saucer, and a tabby cat sleeping on a stool. Light: soft side light from the upper left. Expression: a dreamy, uncertain, guilty look, the eyes turned up to the ceiling and the lip caught between the teeth around the paper. A faint green.

people.imagined: The road north in spring with the Pivot's jars. He walks under the carrying-yoke with a jar hung at each end, the left shoulder visibly lower and wider, whistling.
people.subject: The moment: walking along a spring road under a heavy carrying yoke with a jar at each end, whistling. Face: a broad, kindly, weathered face; thick black brows; calm small brown eyes; a flat nose; a wide mouth in a quiet whistle; a day's stubble. Hair: black, cropped, a rag round the forehead. Body: stocky and enormously strong, the right shoulder dropped a hand lower than the left and the left a hand wider and thicker, the asymmetry plain under the tunic; his stride is long and rolling, the head up. Clothing: a plain brown tunic of good coarse cloth over green leggings tied at the knee, clean; a green armband on the left sleeve; a leather pad across the left shoulder where the yoke rests; sandals; a bamboo flask swinging at his belt. Hands and objects: both hands hold the yoke ropes; two big clay jars sealed with clay hang at the ends, unmarked. Background: The spring road runs between flooded paddies, each reflecting the blue sky, with a line of small figures far ahead, a row of white egrets lifting off a dyke, a few pink peach trees in blossom, and heavy cream-coloured clouds. Light: clear bright morning light from the upper left. Expression: a content, steady, proud look, the small calm eyes on the road and the wide mouth pursed in a quiet whistle. A faint earthy brown-red tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the founder at her sweet spring in 660, kneeling to taste the water from her cupped hands, the first discovery of the wine.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder at forty-five, kneeling at a clear spring, raising water in her cupped hands. Face: a quiet, patient, plain face; skin brown from paddies; calm dark eyes, wide with attention; level thick brows; a short straight nose; a soft mouth in a tiny wondering smile. Hair: black, in a plain bun under a wide straw hat tipped back, a single white flower. Body: sturdy, slim and bent, kneeling. Her feet are bare and brown and sunk in damp earth, and a small clay pot rests beside her with a few green leaves floating in water. Clothing: a simple healer's robe of green hemp, well made, with a white sash, the skirt kilted to the knee; bare muddy feet. She is bent forward from the waist on both knees, the straw hat tipped back on her neck, her forearms wet to the elbow; the sleeves are tied back with strips of cloth and the skirt is kilted up and muddy at the hem. Hands and objects: both hands lifted, cupped, with clear water falling in drops; a bamboo ladle beside her. Background: The spring wells out of a small pool ringed with grey stones, rushes and yellow flag iris at its edge, a line of paddies beyond with a single egret standing in them, thin silver mist lifting off the plain, and a pale sky of low clouds. Light: soft light from the upper left glinting off the water. Expression: a gentle, absorbed look, the eyes lowered on the water in her hand and the soft mouth almost smiling, as if the spring were telling her something. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint green.

people.imagined: Remembered: the healer at the gate of Cựu Khê, stepping into the sick town alone before anyone else dared, a cloth over his mouth, looking straight at the street.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a healer of forty-eight stepping into a plague-town street alone, a cloth tied over his mouth and nose, his eyes fixed ahead. Face: a lean, earnest, brown face; the lower half under a white cloth; bright intense dark eyes under heavy straight brows set in a frown; a high forehead with a bead of sweat. Hair: black and tied in a rough topknot with a strip of green cloth. Body: tall, thin and straight, striding, his stride long and urgent with one foot lifted, the shoulders square and the chin up. Clothing: a healer's robe of green cloth, wet with sweat at the neck and tied up at the knees, the coat tails flying and the sleeves tied back with cords; a white sash tight at the waist; at the belt a roll of needles in green silk with a white tie and a small gourd of wine. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a lit lantern; the left carries a bundle of herbs tied with cord. Background: a narrow empty street of shuttered wooden doors each marked with a single chalk cross, a handcart abandoned in the road with a covered shape on it, a dog slinking in a doorway, a heavy low grey sky and a thin line of smoke from a funeral pyre in the distance. Light: pale grey light from the upper left. Expression: a set, unafraid stare, the bright intense eyes fixed ahead under a hard frown and a bead of sweat on the forehead. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint green-grey.

people.imagined: On the shore at night, waiting for a boat that has not come. She has a sick man on her back and a stoop from years of it, shifting the weight and glaring across the black water.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a lake shore at night with a sick man's arms hanging over her shoulders, glaring across the water. Face: a strong, kind, plain face; skin sun-browned; firm straight brows pulled together; sharp, tired dark eyes; a wide nose; a set mouth; a bead of sweat at the temple. Hair: black, wrapped tight in a green kerchief. Body: sturdy, bent forward at the shoulders under the weight in a deep, old stoop, her knees bent and her feet wide, the patient's head lolling against her neck and his bare feet dangling near her knees. Clothing: a healer's robe of green cloth in a travelling cut, tucked up with a cord at the hip, a plain white sash wound tight; a small wooden needle-shaped amulet on a thong; strong boots; her forearms strong and tendoned. Hands and objects: both hands hold the wrists of the limp patient's arms across her chest; a gold-coloured needle case hangs at her belt. Background: The shore is black pebble and wet sand with a line of tangled reeds, a boat's lantern far across the water, a half-moon behind a rag of cloud laying a pale road on the lake, and a small fire burning on the bank where a blanket and a pack lie ready. Light: pale moonlight from the upper left. Expression: a stern, tired glare across the water, the brows pulled hard together and the mouth set, impatient with the far shore and unshakable under the load. A faint green.

people.imagined: At the Spring House door at dawn. He has checked the latch twice, and now bends to check the clay seal on a jar for the third time while a gauge hangs from his belt.
people.subject: The moment: bent close over a clay jar at a door at dawn, thumb pressing its seal, his other hand still on the latch behind him. Face: a narrow, neat, anxious face; skin pale; small careful eyes with dark rings; thin tidy brows; a thin nose; a small tight mouth; a thin moustache trimmed to a line. Hair: black, combed flat and tied neatly under a plain cap of green cloth. Body: thin, neat and a little stooped, the shoulders hunched and the elbows tucked, his weight shifted onto the left foot as if about to step away. Clothing: a fine green jacket buttoned to the throat under a clean brown cellarman's apron; a white sash knotted in a double knot; a round brass gauge on a cord at his hip, its small face carrying a single needle. Hands and objects: the right thumb pressed on a red clay seal on a jar; the left hand on a heavy iron latch, the knuckles white. Background: The doorway is heavy iron-bound oak set in cold grey stone, rows of clay jars stacked on racks inside with red clay stoppers, a lantern burnt low on a hook, and the first pale strip of dawn showing at the far end of the passage. Light: cold grey-blue dawn light from the upper left. Expression: an anxious, shifty look, the small ringed eyes sliding to the door behind him and the thin mouth pulled tight. A faint water-blue tint.

people.imagined: A night road with a cart. He has a scarf wound twice across his mouth against the lake damp, and only his eyes show, flicking sideways to count who is behind him.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a cart at night with a thick scarf wound twice across the lower face, eyes sliding sideways to check behind. Face: only the upper face is visible: narrow, shifty dark eyes, one brow higher than the other, deep lines at the eye corners, the bridge of a long nose; above a grey wool scarf wound twice round the mouth and chin, the largest feature. Hair: black, under a wide flat cap. Body: wiry and hunched on the cart seat, shoulders pulled forward and elbows on knees, the head turned so that the eyes and the scarf face the viewer while the rest of him points down the road. Clothing: a servant's brown tunic of good cloth with a green armband, a leather vest buttoned to the neck; sandals tied with strips of cloth; a cord of knots, one for each trip, hangs round his neck. Hands and objects: both hands hold the reins loosely. Background: The lake road is a pale line under a heavy dark sky, the cart piled with wet barrels roped under tarred canvas, a mule's head in the blur, a faint lantern ahead and another far behind on the road, and a thin cold mist lying on the black water to the right. Light: dim yellow lantern light from the lower right. Expression: a watchful, calculating look over the scarf, the narrow dark eyes sliding to the road behind and one brow lifted higher than the other. A faint grey-blue damp mist.

people.imagined: At the meadow graves, a drover's widow has just left. She humbly hums to the herbs as she presses seed into a fresh grave, perfectly calm, bent over, while the widow's shadow is still on the path.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling on a fresh mound in a meadow, pressing seeds into the soil with her fingers, humming. Face: a round, calm, pleasant face; skin pale brown; half-closed placid dark eyes cast down; soft round brows; a small nose; a soft closed mouth humming; a streak of earth on the cheek. Hair: brown, in two loose braids, a sprig of herb behind the ear. Body: sturdy and round-shouldered, kneeling with her weight back on her heels and her round face tilted down, her hands calm. Clothing: a healer's robe of green cloth, neat, streaked with earth at the knees, with a white sash, a herb-cloth apron and the sleeves rolled to the elbow; a small bag of seed at her waist. Hands and objects: both hands move with perfect calm, each thumb pressing a single tiny seed into the dark earth; a folded white herb cloth lies beside her. Background: a wide green meadow of low mounds in careful rows, each with a thin line of new sprouts and bunches of herbs in white cloth laid at its head, a path of pale gravel, and in the distance the far figure of a widow in dark clothes walking away with her head down under a bright blue sky. Light: bright afternoon light from the upper left. Expression: a serene, untroubled, slightly too calm look, the half-closed placid eyes cast down and the soft mouth humming. A faint fresh-green.

people.imagined: In the tasting room with her mistress behind her. She sticks out her tongue slightly, deep blue, to test the air of a cup, then covers it with a perfectly composed face.
people.subject: The moment: tasting at a table, the tip of her tongue just showing, stained deep blue, the face above it perfectly calm. Face: a smooth, composed, pretty face with sea-brown skin; calm dark eyes, steady and cool; neat even brows; a small straight nose; the lips slightly parted so that the tongue shows blue to the tip, big and plain; a pale slender neck. Hair: long black hair braided and coiled at the nape with a white shell pin. Body: slim and upright, sitting straight at the table with the elbows in, the slender neck straight and the pale throat showing. Clothing: a healer's robe of fine green cloth with a high collar fastened by a small silver clasp, a white sash tied in a flat bow; a folded taster's cloth over her left shoulder. Hands and objects: both hands hold a small porcelain tasting cup loosely at the chest; before her a tray of seven small white cups in a row. Background: a stone-walled tasting room, cool and dim, racks of dark bottles in the shadows, a single small window of pale light, a brazier with a thin curl of smoke, and the blurred shoulder of a tall still woman in dark green standing behind her, her face turned away. Light: soft amber light from the upper left. Expression: a serene, composed, perfectly cool look, the lips parted just enough to show the blue tongue, concealing everything behind it. A faint blue-green.

people.imagined: At dawn at the oar of the Dawn Hall's boat, a white nick through his eyebrow, rowing hard across the grey lake, looking back at the shore with a sly smile as he counts the silver in his sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: rowing a boat at dawn, with a sly sideways grin, a white nick cutting through his left eyebrow. Face: a lean, sharp, sun-darkened face; the left eyebrow split by a clean white scar, plain and prominent; bright shrewd eyes; a long nose; a broad grin with a gold tooth; stubble. Hair: black, tied with a blue rag. Body: lean, broad-chested, strong forearms. Clothing: a plain green boatman's jacket of good cloth, sleeves rolled, a white sash tied round the waist; bare feet. He leans back into the stroke with his feet braced and his arms straight, the sleeves rolled to the shoulder showing sinew; his head is turned to the shore with the scarred eyebrow to the viewer. The green boatman's jacket has a white sash tied in front and a silver coin sewn into the cuff, the bare feet are wide and brown, and a heavy sleeve sags with the little bag. Hands and objects: both hands grip a long wooden oar; one sleeve sags with a small heavy bag. Background: The lake is a wide pewter sheet with a thin line of pink at the horizon, the boat's wake a long white V behind it, a pair of dark barrels in the stern covered with a net, and the pale stone landing of the Dawn Hall far behind with a small waving figure. Light: cool pink dawn light from the upper left. Expression: a cheerful, shifty grin tipped to one side, the white nick cutting through his eyebrow and the eyes sliding sideways to check who is watching. A faint water-blue gleam.

people.imagined: Stirring a big vat with a long paddle. He has tasted something and is carefully, slowly holding the paddle still, his pink-scalded tongue-tip between his lips, trying to decide who to tell.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a big vat with a long wooden paddle, tongue-tip touching his lip, frowning with slow thought. Face: a broad, honest, slow face; wide-set round brown eyes; thick brows lifted; a snub nose; the pink scalded tongue-tip showing, plainly. Hair: brown, cropped, steam-damp. Body: big and soft-shouldered, standing with the paddle upright like a staff, the shoulders hunched and the chin lowered. Clothing: a plain green jacket of good cloth under a brown leather apron darkened with wet; a white sash; the sleeves pushed up above forearms red from steam, a bit of white foam clinging to his wrist. Hands and objects: both big hands wrap a long wooden paddle; steam rises from a huge dark vat, and the scalded pink tongue-tip rests on his lower lip. Background: The brewing hall is huge, with a row of dark oak vats the height of a house, rafters lost in steam, a high window letting down a column of pale light, a boy carrying a pail in blur, and a ladder with a rope hung over the nearest vat's rim. Light: warm hazy steam light from the upper left. Expression: a puzzled, worried, slow frown, the wide-set brown eyes lifted and the pink tongue-tip caught against the lip as he works something out. A faint blue-green.
